purpose: Context narrows projection and permission without changing canonical person/address or silently exposing private state.
laws: CONTEXT MODULATES EXPRESSION; IT DOES NOT CREATE AUTHORITY
PUBLIC CAPACITY MAY BE COARSE; PRIVATE CAUSE STAYS PRIVATE
CULTURE/REGISTER RULES MUST BE EXPLICIT DONORS, NOT UNIVERSAL STEREOTYPES
TIME/PHASE MAY CHANGE THE RIGHT MOVE
SILENCE ALONE IS NOT PROOF OF DANGER, INCAPACITY OR DEATH
CONFIRMED CONTINUITY EVENTS REQUIRE HUMAN OR AUTHORITATIVE EVIDENCE

reconstructed_conceptual_donors.name: I Ching / Taixuan operational framing
retained_mechanisms: principle / human agency / resources as unequal registers

relation.description: How this address is related to the other party. Unknown is valid.

audience.description: Changes projection grammar, never authority by itself.

language.description: Language of expression; separate from register and relation.

culture_pack_ref.description: Explicit etiquette/decorum donor for a language/community/occasion. Absence means do not invent culture-specific rules.

register.description: Expression register, independent of semantic intent.

phase.description: Current transition phase; used as attention/timing, not divination.

communication_capacity.description: Derived communication capacity only; not a diagnosis.
communication_capacity.public_rule: Project only the coarse derived state if explicitly enabled. Never expose underlying private reason by default.

private_context_refs.description: Opaque references to private state such as routine/training/lifestyle experiments, travel, workload or other conditions that may affect communication.

continuity_state.description: Continuity state is evidence-gated. The last two states are private and require explicit confirmation.

projection_order: interpret message without granting new authority
shape expression through Laconic/Iconic or another declared projection
